questions.subject: math
questions.title: Find the missing side
questions.instruction: This right triangle has a 30° angle and a 10 cm hypotenuse. What is the side opposite 30°?
questions.feedback: The opposite side is 10 × sin(30°) = 5 cm.

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Explore the prism
questions.instruction: Rotate the rectangular prism. Its edges are 2 cm, 3 cm, and 4 cm. What is its volume?
questions.feedback: Multiply all three edge lengths: 2 × 3 × 4 = 24 cm³.

questions.subject: math
questions.title: Read the formula
questions.instruction: Use the formula to find the area when the base is 6 cm and the height is 4 cm.

questions.subject: trivia
questions.title: Quick quiz
questions.instruction: For 10 points: which animal in the picture is an amphibian?
questions.image_alt: Illustration showing a fox, a bat, a frog, and an owl outdoors.
questions.feedback: The frog is an amphibian. It can live in water and on land.

questions.subject: trivia
questions.title: Animal expert
questions.instruction: Which TWO animals in the picture are mammals? Choose both before checking.
questions.image_alt: Illustration showing a fox, a bat, a frog, and an owl outdoors.
questions.feedback: The fox and bat are mammals. The frog is an amphibian and the owl is a bird.

questions.subject: english
questions.title: Fill the gap
questions.instruction: Complete the sentence: We stayed inside ___ it was raining.
questions.feedback: “Because” gives the reason we stayed inside.

questions.subject: english
questions.title: Build the sentence
questions.instruction: Drag the word tiles into a clear sentence, or select a tile and use the arrow buttons.
questions.feedback: “After the rain stopped, we played outside” puts the time phrase first.

questions.subject: english
questions.title: Be the editor
questions.instruction: Correct the grammar: She don't like apples.
questions.feedback: With “she,” use “doesn't”: She doesn't like apples.
